summary.en: A marker underlines one word of a title at rest in one quick stroke; or a highlighter fills its lower half, or a ruled line draws under it.
summary.zh: 标题落定后，一支马克笔在一个词下面快速划一道；或荧光笔铺满词的下半身，或一条直线从词下画出。

fits: Pointing at the one word of a settled title that carries the claim (new, faster, the product).
notFor: More than one word per title; a title still moving or still entering (mark it after it lands, e.g. after type-enter); long phrases that wrap.

intent.en: One hand-drawn stroke lifts a word out of the type, like someone circling the point on a poster, so the viewer knows which word is the claim.
intent.zh: 一笔手绘把一个词从排版里拎出来，像有人拿笔在海报上圈重点，观众知道主张落在哪个词上。

content.en: A title already on screen and the one word or short phrase in it to mark (≤ 12 chars, on one line).
content.zh: 一行已在画面上的标题，以及其中要划的那个词或短词组（≤ 5 字，不跨行）。

fits.zh: 指出已落定标题里承载主张的那一个词（new、更快、产品名）。

notFor.zh: 一个标题里标不止一个词；还在动或还在入场的标题（等它落定再划，比如接在 type-enter 之后）；会折行的长词组。

pairs.note: set the title first, then mark its key word

en: Fast: one stroke in 8–12 frames; slower it reads as a progress bar.
Keep it close under the letters; set apart it reads as a divider, not emphasis.
Follow the slant of the type: under an italic word the stroke rises left to right; slanted the wrong way it looks fake at once.
zh: 要快：8–12 帧一笔划完，慢了读作进度条。
贴着字底，离远了读作分隔线而不是强调。
跟着字势：斜体词下的划线左低右高，斜反了一眼假。

upstream.name: 马克笔下划线
upstream.summary: 大标题落定后，关键词下方马克笔下划线从左到右快速描画——变宽笔形、毛糙边缘、微上斜跟随斜体字势，贴着字底
upstream.use: 标题里强调单个关键词（new/free/AI…）；手写感/人味的品牌调性；正文标注式强调
upstream.energy: 低（一笔点睛，不抢标题的戏）

upstream.name: 误删重打
upstream.summary: 打字机 error-retype——误删重打的"改口"三幕剧：打出平庸词 → 犹豫 → 退格删掉 → 更快打出卖点词
upstream.use: slogan/卖点字卡、否定式文案；文字自带时间性的入场

upstream.name: 纸张标题卡
upstream.summary: 一句话逐词压印上纸、一个词标强调色斜体、短划线收束
upstream.use: 章节转场/价值主张字卡；重要功能出场前的引导卡；全片呼吸位
upstream.energy: 低（呼吸位，隔开两段高能镜头）

overlaps.note: type-retype ends with the same highlighter bar under the retyped words
the loud peak on one word (a charge of light, or hollow lit solid); marker-stroke is a quiet hand mark under a settled title
